reason: The Routing number field sets aria-invalid and an aria-errormessage that points to a real, visible span with the text 'Routing # should be a 9-digit number', and the accessibility tree exposes both. Nothing announces the message when it appears (the alert region is empty and aria-describedby points to a missing helptext id), so screen readers that ignore aria-errormessage may not read the reason. The error is also shown in text with an icon next to the field, so the impact is minor.
